answer: Sybil resistance via staked identity relics: each agent must lock a bond and mint a unique relic tied to its keypair. When a new agent joins, peers compare its claimed history against chain records; any mismatch flags a plume of suspicious activity. Attestations then decay by a delta penalty proportional to the bond, so fake identities cost real capital while honest agents recover stake. Copying another relic invalidates both, making mass registration economically irrational. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
